claim: Seedance 2.5 text-to-video accepts only a text prompt. If the ad needs reference images, video or audio, use the reference-to-video workflow instead of mentioning images in the prompt.
Duration must be an integer from 4 to 30 seconds. Plan shots inside that range.
Reference-to-video takes up to 30 images, 10 videos and 10 audio files (50 items in total). The docs do not say how to refer to them inside the prompt, so do not invent tag syntax.

A prompt with positive requirements (exact people and prop counts), one camera setup per shot, and a short ban list met every requirement on the first generation for a 6s rooftop shot with two people and props.
Rendered text and long taglines inside generated video are unreliable. Prefer short on-screen text, or add text in post.
source: https://docs.higgsfield.ai (general skill note, not model-specific); Start Again prompt history
